# RF-CBC-002 Pediatric CBC Deepen Pass (excerpt)

This deepen pass produced net-new candidate rows and avoided re-emitting the four already-committed
patterns. The strongest openly retrievable numeric anchors came from CALIPER 2020 for age-banded WBC
and MCV intervals, and from open pediatric ITP guidance for platelet action bands.

Where a row is derived from a reference interval boundary rather than a source-stated disease cutoff,
it is labeled `inference` instead of `assertion`. That distinction matters most for the
CALIPER-based leukocytosis rows: they are useful fallback candidate bands, but they should not
outrank the module's already-committed local-lab-range precedence behavior. fileciteturn0file0
